caption: The drawing features a symmetrical, circular object with a mechanical or ornamental design. The central part of the image shows a large round disk with a raised center, decorated with intricate patterns resembling dots and small leaf shapes in muted green, red, and gray colors. Surrounding this central disk are ten evenly spaced spokes, each ending in a smaller, similarly patterned circular disk. The spokes and circles are primarily in gray tones with red accents. The outer circles are detailed with repeating dotted patterns and star-like designs. Attached to the bottom of the central disk is a metallic-looking object that appears cylindrical and is shaded in gray, with a scalloped edge at its base. The entire composition is placed on a plain, off-white background, with no other objects present in the image. Near the bottom right of the circular object, there is a small red stamp or signature.
title: Candleholder (Candelero) Cut Tin
